items.title: Was the public source file suitable for the audit?

source.label: DRUM VIIRS dataset and local quality report

metricDefinitions.label: Observation group
metricDefinitions.definition: An observation group is one FEDS fire event, one satellite, and one exact UTC acquisition time.

filters: Source sample: author-selected western US large-fire pixels from 2020
Classification: confidence and fire_mask must agree
caveats: The table contains selected detections rather than complete no-fire or no-observation overpasses.

items.title: What changed after separating candidate inclusion from FRP retrieval?
assumptions: Candidate weight w=1 includes every author-selected candidate at full recalculated FRP; it is not a truth probability.

source.label: Generated empirical analysis

metricDefinitions.label: Candidate inclusion effect
metricDefinitions.definition: Candidate inclusion compares recalculated FRP from known pixels plus weighted candidate pixels against recalculated FRP from known pixels alone.

metricDefinitions.label: Retrieval effect
metricDefinitions.definition: The retrieval effect compares recalculated and original FRP on identical known pixels with both values present.

filters: Observation grouping: exact UTC time within event and satellite
Retrieval comparison: matched known pixels only
caveats: Sample sums combine recorded instantaneous FRP values descriptively; they are not FRE, emissions, or a time-integrated energy estimate.
No independent truth labels were joined, so these results do not estimate precision or recall.

evidenceFlow.title: Effect separation
evidenceFlow.detail: The candidate-inclusion ratio used recalculated FRP for both known and candidate pixels. The retrieval ratio used only matched known pixels, preventing candidate selection and FRP-method changes from sharing one comparison.

evidenceFlow.title: Comparison coverage
evidenceFlow.detail: All 706,876 known pixels had both recalculated and original FRP in the downloaded file, giving 100% retrieval comparison coverage.

sourceRoles.label: outputs/strata_metrics.csv
sourceRoles.role: Contains day/night, satellite, and view-angle summaries with sample sizes.

sourceRoles.label: Related source paper DOI
sourceRoles.role: Identifies the peer-reviewed study associated with the public table.

methods.code:
Candidate inclusion = (new known + new candidates − new known) / new known
Retrieval change = (new matched known − old matched known) / old matched known
Combined change = (new known + new candidates − old known) / old known
